initialExam.title: India Post GDS Recruitment 2026
initialExam.conductingBody: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications
initialExam.description: India Post recruits Gramin Dak Sevaks for mail delivery, banking, and postal services in rural areas. One of the largest recruitments.
initialExam.syllabus: No exam. Selection based on 10th class marks merit.
initialExam.examPattern: Merit-based on 10th standard marks. No written exam or interview.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Application → Merit List (10th marks) → Document Verification → Appointment
initialExam.jobRole: Gramin Dak Sevak for mail delivery and postal services in rural areas
initialExam.careerGrowth: GDS → Postman/Mail Guard → Postal Assistant through departmental exam.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit indiapostgdsonline.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: TRCA, Paid leave, Risk/Hardship allowance, Insurance
